raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared the birth years of the two directors. It stated that Edwin L. Marin (born 1899) was born later than Lina Wertmüller (born 1928). This is a logical error in chronological comparison: 1899 is earlier than 1928, not later. Consequently, the Planner drew the wrong conclusion that "Henry Goes Arizona" has the director born later, when in fact "The Blue Collar Worker And The Hairdresser In A Whirl Of Sex And Politics" (directed by Wertmüller, born 1928) has the director born later.
